source.title: Backscatter factors and mass energy-absorption coefficient ratios for surface dose determination in diagnostic radiology
source.institution: Karolinska University Hospital, Department of Hospital Physics
source.bibliographic_note: The supplied report has three authors, not Bouchard. No journal-version data have been substituted.

k_bs.definition: K_air at water entrance surface (primary + backscatter) / incident K_air free in air at same position

k_f.definition: K_water / K_air, both evaluated with the total primary + backscatter spectrum at water entrance surface

product.definition: entrance surface water kerma / incident air kerma

output.definition: entrance surface water kerma, approximated as absorbed dose to water under local electron energy deposition

geometry.position: centre of flat entrance surface; square field, normal central-axis incidence
geometry.field_reference: phantom entrance surface, plane perpendicular to beam
geometry.lateral_extent_section_3_2: variable, margin exceeding 5 cm at beam exit
geometry.inconsistency: A fixed 30 x 30 cm phantom conflicts with the 35 x 35 cm field and section 3.2. Both statements are preserved; no resolution is assumed.

methods.transport: PENELOPE 2008 / PenEasy, electrons deposit locally; photon cutoff 1 keV
methods.clinical_spectra: SpekCalc tungsten spectra, kVp and inherent Al / added Cu as tabulated. No numeric anode angle supplied for each Table 3 row.
methods.mono_database_vs_table: Text: 44 simulated energies 4-150 keV. Table 1 publishes only 30 energies 5-150 keV in 5 keV steps. No reconstruction below 5 keV.
methods.spectral_averaging: Published Tables 3/4 used directly. No spectrum convolution implemented; in particular no substitution of kVp or mean energy for monoenergetic energy.
methods.uncertainty: Report estimates ~0.3% for calculated monoenergetic factors; this is not a combined patient-model uncertainty or an independently assigned uncertainty to each clinical factor.

monoenergetic.use: monoenergetic lookup only; not inferred from clinical kVp

clinical.use: event calculation for explicitly declared tungsten / Al family; h and HVL retained as descriptors

comparison.use: archive and independent full-MC vs averaging comparison only; not mixed into Table 3 grid

mammography.use: archive only, outside interventional event provider; water not glandular dose

interpolation.method: piecewise multilinear in original coordinates, exact at nodes
interpolation.clinical: fixed tabulated Al family; linear, bilinear or trilinear in kVp, Cu and square side
interpolation.out_of_domain: error; no clamping, nearest-neighbour fallback, or extrapolation
interpolation.optional_shape_approximation: equal_area: sqrt(width*height), explicitly requested and audited; not validated by report

source_issues: Table 3 h_original > 1 in 24 quality rows (Al=3.1, kVp=120-150): preserved and flagged; excluded from interpolation.
Table 2 printed coefficient-ratio differences reach 1.3%, despite smaller BSF differences discussed in text.
Equation 12 averaging expression is not used to generate new spectra; Eq.9 defines the total-spectrum ratio.
